concerns.text: FR-005 requires the system to run on CPU‑only resources (no GPU) with ≤7 GB RAM and ≤6 h runtime. While runtime is checked by T014, there is no explicit task that verifies the pipeline does not request or depend on GPU resources. Add a task (e.g., T018) that validates the execution environment is CPU‑only (e.g., checks that no CUDA libraries are imported or that the CI configuration disables GPU).
